section_summary: Pages 80–139 continue schedules of Japanese patents and utility models assigned to General Electric licensees, including Tokyo, Shibaura, and Tokyo Shibaura companies. The later correspondence concerns American and Swiss patent interests in postwar Japan, along with Northern Equipment’s Japanese bank deposits and International General Electric’s financial interests.

subfiles.title: Patents on G.E. inventions assigned to Tokyo Co.
subfiles.about: Lists Japanese patents on General Electric inventions assigned to Tokyo Co.
subfiles.summary: Continuation of a numbered patent schedule giving publication and grant dates, invention titles, and docket numbers. The entries on these pages cover technologies including lamps, discharge devices, radio systems, meters, glass manufacture, and electrical controls.

subfiles.title: Utility models on G.E. inventions assigned to Shibaura Co. and Tokyo Co.
subfiles.about: Lists Japanese utility models on General Electric inventions assigned to Shibaura Co. and Tokyo Co.
subfiles.summary: The schedule records utility model numbers, publication and grant dates, titles, and docket references. Separate numbered runs identify assignments to Shibaura and Tokyo companies, with entries spanning refrigeration, motors, electrical controls, lamps, switches, and other equipment.

subfiles.title: Utility models originating with G.E. licensees
subfiles.about: Lists utility models originating with licensees and assigned to Shibaura, Tokyo Shibaura, or Tokyo companies.
subfiles.summary: The two-page schedule gives utility model identifiers, dates, titles where available, and docket or foreign application references.

subfiles.title: Patents on G.E. inventions assigned to Tokyo-Shibaura Electric Co.
subfiles.about: Lists patents on General Electric inventions assigned to Tokyo Shibaura companies.
subfiles.summary: The schedule provides patent numbers, dates, invention titles, and docket numbers. Its headings use several forms of the Tokyo Shibaura company name and include electrical, mechanical, chemical, and manufacturing inventions.

subfiles.title: Patents on inventions originating with G.E. licensees
subfiles.about: Lists patents originating with General Electric licensees and assigned to Tokyo, Tokyo Shibaura, or Shibaura companies.
subfiles.summary: These patent tables give grant and publication dates, titles, and docket or foreign application references. Many entries concern electric lamps and discharge devices; the final page also lists electrical controls, welding, and other inventions assigned to Shibaura.

subfiles.title: State Department reply to J. A. H. Torry
subfiles.from: James W. Gantenbein, for the Acting Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Acknowledges International General Electric’s information on its Japanese and Korean patent interests.
subfiles.summary: The Department says it forwarded the material to the Political Adviser in Tokyo and will report back.

subfiles.title: Northern Equipment follow-up on Japanese patents
subfiles.about: Requests an answer to its May 18 inquiry about patents and other accounts in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Northern Equipment asks for a reply to its earlier letter.

subfiles.title: Department of State transfer sheet
subfiles.about: Records the transfer of correspondence between file numbers.
subfiles.summary: A filing form records a transfer involving Tokyo correspondence.

subfiles.title: Note on Northern Equipment correspondence
subfiles.about: Notes a Northern Equipment letter dated May 18.
subfiles.summary: Brief handwritten note referring to Northern Equipment’s May 18 letter.

subfiles.title: American Viscose inquiry about Japanese patents
subfiles.about: Asks about using Japanese-issued patents in the United States when no U.S. patent may have issued.
subfiles.summary: Rose seeks the applicable policy and the office responsible for information about those patents.

subfiles.title: Reply to American Viscose patent inquiry
subfiles.about: Requests details needed to answer Rose’s inquiry about Japanese patents.
subfiles.summary: Martin asks for the owner’s identity and location and the patent or invention’s exact status.

subfiles.title: Northern Equipment statement on Japanese bank accounts
subfiles.from: Northern Equipment Company; E. W. Scarlett
subfiles.about: Reports Northern Equipment’s Japanese bank deposits and requests their status.
subfiles.summary: The company identifies deposits at the 100th Bank and Yokohama Specie Bank, including funds deposited by its licensee Gadelius Co. It asks about balances and interest and certifies its Pennsylvania incorporation and share ownership.

subfiles.title: State Department reply to Northern Equipment
subfiles.from: James W. Gantenbein, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Northern Equipment’s sworn statements and requests patent tax payment dates.
subfiles.summary: The Department says it sent the patent and bank deposit statements to the Political Adviser in Tokyo for investigation. It lists the patent details investigators require and asks for the last date taxes were paid on each patent.

subfiles.title: Instruction to Political Adviser on Northern Equipment interests
subfiles.to: United States Political Adviser to the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, Tokyo
subfiles.about: Requests investigation and protection of Northern Equipment’s patent and bank deposit interests.
subfiles.summary: The instruction forwards sworn statements and notes that patent tax payment dates have been requested.

subfiles.title: Charge slip for Northern Equipment enclosure
subfiles.about: Records circulation of an enclosure concerning Northern Equipment correspondence.
subfiles.summary: File charge slip referring to Northern Equipment letters and Department instruction 254.

subfiles.title: Internal note on Northern Equipment Japanese patents
subfiles.about: Checks departmental records concerning Northern Equipment’s Japanese patents.
subfiles.summary: Brief note says FA has no record and asks another office to check.

subfiles.title: Northern Equipment statement of Japanese patent interests
subfiles.from: Northern Equipment Company; E. W. Scarlett
subfiles.about: Identifies four Japanese patents and requests an accounting and restoration of patent rights.
subfiles.summary: Northern Equipment lists four patents for control valves and states that Gadelius & Co. was its sole authorized Japanese manufacturer. It requests an accounting for wartime manufacturing permits, reimbursement, and restoration of its patents and pending applications to their prewar status.

subfiles.title: Swiss Legation note on Geigy DDT patent application
subfiles.from: Chargé d’Affaires ad interim of Switzerland
subfiles.about: Requests investigation of J. R. Geigy’s Japanese DDT patent application and possible royalties.
subfiles.summary: The Legation reports that Geigy filed an application in 1942 and later learned of DDT manufacture in Japan. It asks whether a patent issued and whether the manufacturer owes royalties to an occupation-designated agency.

subfiles.title: State Department reply to Swiss Legation
subfiles.about: Responds to the request for investigation of Geigy’s DDT patent interests in Japan.
subfiles.summary: The Department says it is conveying the substance of the Swiss note to the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers. It suggests that Switzerland’s representative in Japan directly request an inquiry.
keywords: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers

subfiles.title: International General Electric statement of Japanese financial interests
subfiles.from: Arthur T. Brown, International General Electric Company
subfiles.about: Supplies approximate values of International General Electric’s Japanese securities, bank balances, and debts.
subfiles.summary: The letter begins an accounting omitted from the company’s July 17 submission. It values its Tokyo Shibaura Electric shares at approximately ¥56.7 million in December 1941 and describes their forced sale in 1943. The letter continues beyond this section.
